subject.title: fix: provider usage accounting, retry/overflow classification, and output clamping

question: Should an omitted Anthropic `maxRetries` preserve the provider primitive's existing SDK behavior, or should every caller now receive zero SDK retries because OpenClaw owns retries externally?
rationale: This changes a public provider-call contract and can affect plugin or direct consumers outside the main agent retry loop; code inspection cannot determine whether that compatibility break is intentional.

options.title: Preserve unset semantics
options.body: Recommended: pass zero only from callers that own an outer retry policy and leave omitted provider options unchanged for direct and plugin consumers.

options.title: Adopt zero globally
options.body: Intentionally redefine the provider primitive to disable SDK retries everywhere, with explicit compatibility documentation and direct-caller tests.

options.title: Split the retry change
options.body: Land the independent accounting and classifier fixes separately while the retry contract receives focused maintainer review.

recommendation.title: Preserve unset semantics
recommendation.body: Recommended: pass zero only from callers that own an outer retry policy and leave omitted provider options unchanged for direct and plugin consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available connection to the provider primitive, outer runtime retry policy, and affected public surface.
